title: The final keyword on variables, methods, and classes
answer: `final` has context-specific meaning. A final variable can be assigned only once; a final instance field must be definitely assigned during initialization. A final method cannot be overridden by subclasses, though it can be inherited. A final class cannot be extended. AeroTopo demonstrates all three forms: final fields such as `Product.id`, final method `Product.id()`, and final concrete class `Orthomosaic`. None of these automatically makes every reachable object immutable.
